title: SecureSpeech: Prompt-based Speaker and Content Protection

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring variations in downstream utility and quality metrics (Word Error Rate and Predicted Mean Opinion Score) of the anonymized speech when altering the accent attribute in text-to-speech prompt descriptions.

Measuring variations in speech utility and quality metrics (Word Error Rate and Predicted Mean Opinion Score) when altering the speaker's gender (female vs. male) in text-to-speech prompt descriptions.
Evaluating discrepancies in speech utility and quality metrics by systematically varying prompt-based speaker attributes such as pitch, pitch modulation, speaking rate, and channel condition.
